## Outcome
Validate a narrowly scoped 0.4.1 executable release with explicit, truthful security claims and independent review.


## Scope
Review working tree and release scope; ensure experimental paths are intentionally included or excluded; execute existing build, tests, package size, seal and installed-candidate checks. Full T015 security acceptance remains deferred and must not be claimed.


## Plan (Todo Tree)
- [x] 1. [START] Review release scope and experimental changes
- [x] 2. [after:1] Build and run release regressions
- [x] 3. [after:2] [ACCEPTANCE] Verify installed candidate and submit evidence for independent QA


## Prove
Full regression and installed-candidate acceptance pass under compile.md; document package size, seal, limitations and independent review.

## Handover
- [2026-11-26 08:12 UTC]: Candidate-05 installed and relocated smoke now explicitly fail if Snowflake connector Arrow unavailable and passed. Full suite 2322 passed, 2 skipped. Independent QA unavailable per user; submit to verify without claiming approval.
- [2026-11-26 07:56 UTC]: Installed candidate acceptance continues separately; no QA verdict.
- [2026-11-26 07:51 UTC]: Candidate-05 two-pass build completed, including fail-closed Snowflake Arrow offline smoke and encrypted write. ZIP 57,816,357 bytes; SHA-256 4dfb3f15a81e9237b4b2c0f9b2fb82f0d04677d79932af8ee5eb2810c75d5859. Installed proof and full regression started; no release or QA verdict.
- [2026-11-26 07:21 UTC]: Offline direct import probe against same long installed runtime: ordinary site-packages path disabled Snowflake Arrow; extended-length path enabled it. Updated sealed bootstrap to use extended site path after verification; focused bootstrap/seal tests passed 61. Fresh compiled candidate and installed proofs remain required.
- [2026-11-26 07:09 UTC]: Authorized offline comparison: candidate-04 compiled runtime smoke completed without Arrow import warning; installed clean-profile runtime emitted nanoarrow filename-too-long warning while returning zero. This supports path-length sensitivity, but neither candidate includes the new fail-closed Arrow assertion. No QA verdict or release.
- [2026-11-25 10:04 UTC]: QA reported installed connector ArrowResult import failure at long path despite smoke exit zero. Added explicit CAN_USE_ARROW_RESULT_FORMAT check to release smoke so missing native Arrow cannot pass silently. Resolving underlying load issue and rebuilding/retesting remains required; previous candidate not release-ready.
- [2026-11-25 09:59 UTC]: Independent reviewer submitted no QA verdict (kanban_qa unavailable); ticket remains verify. Reviewer found installed smoke logs a Snowflake connector ArrowResult/nanoarrow import error 'filename or extension is too long' despite smoke exit 0. This is a release blocker pending investigation; no publication. Board identity: this ticket is on current central board C:\Projects\kanbanBoard\board, distinct from historical C:\Projects\Board Notes.
- [2026-11-25 09:48 UTC]: Final regression on candidate source with approved extension: 2322 passed, 2 skipped, 700 warnings (184.65 s). Candidate-04 clean-profile proof passed, ZIP 57,815,169 bytes, SHA256 bb1a84f23716011c5c1c695c9940a5b353d38eebe9ca89619a1e2ff8e5577a43. Independent QA and release approval remain; T015 full security acceptance deferred. No live Snowflake/OAuth or Desktop UI proof.
- [2026-11-25 09:44 UTC]: Final full run after extended-path seal fix had 2 failures (2320 passed, 2 skipped): mocked linked/reparse test paths compared non-prefixed spellings with extended Windows paths. Corrected test fixture comparisons, not the seal; actual candidate installed junction refusal already passed. Focused test_sealed_release.py + test_exe.py passed 61/61. Full suite rerun started; candidate binary unchanged.
- [2026-11-25 09:39 UTC]: Candidate-04 installed proof passed: 57,815,169-byte ZIP, clean-profile first install, encrypted release smoke, one executable, tamper/missing and reparse checks, launcher pin checks. First-install 90.1 s; median repeated --version 7.53 s exe / 7.72 s launcher on this run. No live Snowflake/OAuth or Desktop UI tested, no independent QA or release approval. Full regression rerun after final seal change started.
- [2026-11-25 09:28 UTC]: Rebuilt candidate-04 with extended-length seal fix: two-pass build and offline encrypted DuckDB/PNG/SVG/PDF smoke passed; final ZIP 57,815,169 bytes (<60,000,000), plugin SHA256 bb1a84f23716011c5c1c695c9940a5b353d38eebe9ca89619a1e2ff8e5577a43. New clean-profile installation/tamper proof started. No release or QA approval yet.
- [2026-11-25 09:02 UTC]: Follow-up reproduction corrected prior hypothesis: tar extracted all files, but ordinary Windows path enumeration/stat in verifier omitted deep files; same tree verified after shortening staging root, and extended-length enumeration saw all. Updated seal verification to use extended-length path without resolving links; synthetic deep-path tamper test and related checks passed 17, 1 skipped. Fresh sealed candidate build started; installed proof remains required.
- [2026-11-25 08:49 UTC]: Installed-candidate failure diagnosed: Windows bsdtar silently omitted files whose full extraction paths were >=260 chars in long clean-profile staging; seal correctly rejected incomplete runtime. A shorter scratch root extracted all 4653 files with matching hashes. Need supported long-path extraction or explicit fail-early path limit plus regression; never weaken seal.
- [2026-11-25 08:46 UTC]: Clean-profile installed proof failed: tampered/missing archive refusals passed, but first legitimate unpack refused with 'runtime file list changed'. No release approved or published. Investigating archive extraction versus sealed manifest; must preserve fail-closed verification.
- [2026-11-25 08:45 UTC]: Fresh two-pass sealed 0.4.1 scratch candidate built successfully with approved signed httpfs and BCJ filter; offline release smoke passed encrypted DuckDB and PNG/SVG/PDF, and final plugin ZIP is 57,817,407 bytes (<60,000,000). Clean-profile installed/tamper proof started; independent QA and publication remain outstanding.
- [2026-11-25 08:35 UTC]: Release-mode tests now provision a hash-pinned synthetic sealed extension; missing _seal explicitly fails closed. Full project suite with extension supplied reported 2321 passed, 2 skipped; independent focused tests/test_output_budget.py and tests/test_offline_httpfs.py rerun passed 58/58 (39 warnings). Candidate build remains in progress.
- [2026-11-25 08:20 UTC]: BCJ-filtered LZMA2 archive probe measured 57,677,579 bytes for old scratch runtime plus httpfs; built-in Windows tar extracted it and SHA-256 verification matched all 4,653 files, including extension. Updated builder compression method. Full new two-pass sealed build with signed extension started; final ZIP size and installed proof remain open.
- [2026-11-25 08:18 UTC]: Lossless x86 BCJ+LZMA2 probe of prior candidate runtime plus signed httpfs produced 57,677,579-byte 7z (down from unfiltered 60,920,274); Windows tar listed 5,170 entries. This is not the final sealed candidate or outer plugin ZIP; full extraction/hash verification is running.
- [2026-11-25 08:07 UTC]: Implemented explicit pinned signed httpfs input, included in both sealed runtime passes, and release-only fixed-path writer initialization with extension auto-install/autoload disabled. Official extension synthetic encrypted writer and ledger checks plus storage regressions: 998 passed, 584 warnings. No full compiled rebuild or installed proof yet; measured size probe exceeds cap and reduction investigation is running.
- [2026-11-25 07:59 UTC]: Size probe: recompressed existing scratch candidate runtime plus official signed httpfs into one 7z: 60,920,274 bytes before outer plugin ZIP, already 920,274 bytes above the 60,000,000-byte outer cap. This is an estimate/probe, not a sealed final candidate. Investigating safe size reductions; do not bypass limit or weaken crypto.
- [2026-11-25 07:55 UTC]: User approved official DuckDB HTTPS extension download. DuckDB 1.5.6 windows_amd64 httpfs decompressed SHA-256 9b0b0202cfa34f94f12bd9b2698002735bbcd0c1bd5fda2e85450583efd18e94 matches prior local cache; fresh-process default signature-check load with autoload/install disabled successfully wrote and reopened synthetic encrypted DB. Single-file 7z size 7,464,823 bytes; actual combined size measurement is running, not yet a final package. Extension is not yet integrated or independently security-audited.
- [2026-11-25 07:51 UTC]: Investigation: DuckDB 1.5.6 Windows wheel uses read-only crypto without write-capable httpfs extension in a fresh profile; actual encrypted dataset writers have same dependency. A local cached httpfs binary exists but its observed hash alone is not approved/trusted provenance. Release build currently does not package/load it. Secure fix requires approved provenance/pinning, sealed package, explicit load, security review and offline tests; ZIP limit must be rechecked. No unsafe mbedTLS override, no unapproved download, no release.
- [2026-11-25 07:49 UTC]: Relocated scratch build compiled and sealed sb.exe and passed --version, but --release-smoke failed creating an encrypted DuckDB with 'read-only crypto module loaded'. No plugin ZIP was produced; unsafe crypto override was not used. Investigating secure, offline crypto backend before another build.
- [2026-11-25 07:29 UTC]: After excluding the experimental CLI flags, full .venv pytest tests -q passed: 2316 passed, 2 skipped, 698 warnings in 293.46s. First scratch build failed before execution because the existing build venv points to an obsolete checkout; created a separate scratch venv using the existing pinned Python/build packages and started a fresh candidate build. No installed proof or release yet.
- [2026-11-25 07:24 UTC]: Excluded the three experimental evaluator options from the 0.4.1 CLI parser; prototype and direct synthetic controls remain for future work. Focused documentation, parser rejection, play, chart and related regressions: 83 passed. git diff --check passed with LF/CRLF warnings. Full regression rerun started; release build and installed proof remain outstanding.
- [2026-11-25 07:21 UTC]: Full pytest tests run: 2312 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed; reproduced tests/test_docs_coverage.py::test_every_flag_documented_or_known. Experimental play flags --experimental-evaluator, --evaluator-dll and --reader-dll are undocumented. They expose an unfinished display-only path whose dynamic adapter is not shipped in the sealed release; documenting them alone is not a release fix. Recommend excluding/gating experimental CLI path from 0.4.1 and testing both developer and release behavior; no fix applied yet.
